query_plan.query: Which country hosted the most world cup matches?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by match id and return the id of the venue where the most matches were hosted along with their match names.
steps.query: Return all matches with id and their venue

dependencies.dependency: Venue id and venue name where the most matches were hosted

steps.merge_task: Return as soon as the country id of the according venue ids and venue names is found
steps.query: Find the according country id for the venue id and venue name where the most matches were hosted

dependencies.dependency: Country id and country name where the most matches were hosted

steps.merge_task: Return as soon as the name of the country is found
steps.query: Find the name of the country with the id of the country from the previous step

extra.sql_query: SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS matches_hosted FROM matches m INNER JOIN venues v ON m.venue = v.venue INNER JOIN countries c ON v.country = c.country GROUP BY c.country, c.name ORDER BY matches_hosted DESC LIMIT 1;

s1.sql_query: SELECT matches.match, matches.venue, matches.name FROM matches

s2.sql_query: SELECT venues.venue, venues.country, venues.name FROM venues

s3.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.name FROM countries WHERE countries.country = 30
